title: Motion- and Gravity-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.22177v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only.   We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. translated_title: 运动与重力感知的前馈式三维重建
translated_abstract: 前馈式Transformer模型近年来在多视角三维重建任务中取得了优异的性能，但它们仍主要依赖基于外观的注意力机制，在几何线索薄弱的动态场景中往往表现不佳。在本工作中，我们在“特权信息学习”范式下提出了一种运动与重力感知的框架。在训练阶段，残差光流和重力方向作为特权信号提供，用于引导几何表示的学习；而在推理阶段，模型仅使用标准的视觉输入。我们通过轻量级的架构改动将这些先验信息整合到Transformer骨干网络中，同时保持了前馈推理的高效性。在标准基准上的实验表明，该方法在重建精度和鲁棒性方面带来了一致的提升，尤其是在包含动态物体、结构模糊以及复杂相机运动的场景中。我们的分析进一步表明，最优的注入阶段……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在特权信息学习范式下，训练时以残差光流和重力方向作为特权信号引导几何表示学习、推理时仅需标准视觉输入，通过轻量级架构改动显著提升了前馈式三维重建在动态和复杂场景中的精度与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the LUPI paradigm, where residual optical flow and gravity direction serve as privileged signals during training to guide geometric representation learning, achieving consistent gains in feedforward 3D reconstruction accuracy and robustness with only lightweight architectural changes while using standard visual inputs at inference.
